questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents the relationship: Vehicles, Cars, Buses? [A = three separate circles; B = all nested inside each other; C = two small circles both inside one large circle, no overlap between the small ones; D = three partially overlapping circles]
options: C — two small circles inside one large circle
questions.explanation: Cars and Buses are both Vehicles, but no car is a bus. So both Cars and Buses are subsets of Vehicles, and Cars ∩ Buses = ∅. Diagram C: two small circles (Cars, Buses) inside the large circle (Vehicles) with no overlap between them.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: Scientists, Indians, Writers? [A = separate circles; B = nested; C = two inside one; D = three partially overlapping]
options: C — two circles inside one large
questions.explanation: Some Indians are scientists, some are writers, some scientists are also writers, and an Indian can be both a scientist and a writer. No strict subset relationship exists. Diagram D (three partially overlapping circles) best represents this.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: Squares, Rectangles, Quadrilaterals?
options: Fully nested: Squares inside Rectangles inside Quadrilaterals
Two circles inside one; no overlap between inner circles
questions.explanation: All squares are rectangles; all rectangles are quadrilaterals. So Squares ⊂ Rectangles ⊂ Quadrilaterals. The diagram is fully nested (three concentric-like circles).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: Males, Fathers, Grandfathers?
options: Fully nested: Grandfathers inside Fathers inside Males
questions.explanation: All grandfathers are fathers (they fathered their children); all fathers are males. Hence Grandfathers ⊂ Fathers ⊂ Males — fully nested.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: India, Asia, Earth?
options: Fully nested: India inside Asia inside Earth
questions.explanation: India is a part of Asia; Asia is a part of Earth. All three are geographically nested: India ⊂ Asia ⊂ Earth.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: Mammals, Marine Animals, Whales?
options: Whales inside the overlapping region of Mammals and Marine Animals
Three partially overlapping circles with no element common to all
questions.explanation: Whales are mammals AND marine animals. So Whales ⊂ (Mammals ∩ Marine Animals). Mammals and Marine Animals partially overlap (whales, dolphins) but most mammals are not marine and vice versa. Whales sit inside the intersection of the two larger circles.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: Brothers, Males, Humans?
options: Fully nested: Brothers inside Males inside Humans
Two circles inside one with overlap
questions.explanation: All brothers are males; all males are humans. Brothers ⊂ Males ⊂ Humans — fully nested.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A Venn diagram has three overlapping circles A, B, C. Numbers: only A=12, only B=8, only C=15, A∩B only=5, B∩C only=7, A∩C only=4, all three=3. Find the total in circle A.
questions.explanation: Total in A = only A + A∩B only + A∩C only + all three = 12+5+4+3 = 24.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Using the same Venn (only A=12, only B=8, only C=15, A∩B only=5, B∩C only=7, A∩C only=4, all three=3). How many elements belong to EXACTLY ONE circle?
questions.explanation: Exactly one = only A + only B + only C = 12+8+15 = 35.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: Doctors, Surgeons, Rich people?
options: Surgeons inside Doctors; Rich people separate from both
Surgeons inside Doctors; Doctors and Rich overlap partially
questions.explanation: All surgeons are doctors (Surgeons ⊂ Doctors). Some doctors may be rich; some rich people may be doctors. So Doctors and Rich people partially overlap, with Surgeons fully inside Doctors.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Which Venn diagram BEST represents: Cats, Dogs, Pets?
options: Cats and Dogs both inside Pets; no overlap between Cats and Dogs
Cats inside Dogs; both inside Pets
questions.explanation: All cats and all dogs in this context are pets; no cat is a dog. So two circles (Cats, Dogs) sit inside the large circle (Pets) without overlapping each other.
questions.subject: Reasoning
